description: The state government organised a one-day AI-led Innovation and Capacity Building Conference in Lucknow, signalling its intent to position Uttar Pradesh as a major hub for artificial intelligence, digital skills and emerging technologies.
body_lead: Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh is accelerating its push to build a robust artificial intelligence and future skills ecosystem as part of its broader strategy to drive economic growth, improve governance and enhance employment opportunities , senior state officials said on Tuesday. The state government organised a one-day AI-led Innovation and Capacity Building Conference in Lucknow, signalling its intent to position Uttar Pradesh as a major hub for artificial intelligence, digital skills and emerging technologies.
